create_azure_openai_backend: create an Azure OpenAI backend using sgl.OpenAI with model_name, api_key, and is_azure=True
run_multi_turn_question: run the multi_turn_question function with question_1 and question_2 to get a two-turn chat response
run_streaming_chat: run multi_turn_question with stream=True and iterate state.text_iter() for streaming output
run_batch_questions: run multi_turn_question.run_batch with a list of question dictionaries for parallel requests
set_default_backend: set sgl.OpenAI backend as the default backend using sgl.set_default_backend
